newsitem.title: USA: Oregon says jobless rate rose to 5.6 pct in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Oregon says jobless rate rose to 5.6 pct in Dec.

text.p: Oregon's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate in December rose one-tenth of a percentage point to 5.6 percent from the previous month, the state said on Tuesday.
The December rate compared to 4.9 percent in December 1995, the Oregon Employment Department said in a statement.
Oregon's unemployment rate was 0.3 percentage points higher than the U.S. rate of 5.3 percent in December 1996, the department said.
The state's jobless rate has risen gradually since March 1995 when the rate reached a low of 4.6 percent.
